draft.emotion: firm and decisive, bringing an action to a clear end
notes: Often used reflexively ('pararse') when a person or vehicle stops moving.
Followed by 'de' + infinitive ('parar de llover', 'no para de hablar'), it means to stop doing an ongoing action.

senses.definition: To cease moving or doing an ongoing activity, or to make someone or something stop moving.

examples.emotion: calm and matter-of-fact, describing a routine traffic stop
